title: 第5章 万事俱备的官方公告第6章 玩家来袭望仙门立
lines: 太虚神光的速度远非寻常遁法可比，去时需要寻路探查，还花了些时间。
归来时，不过一盏茶的功夫。
金色流光就掠过无数苍茫的林海与大山，精准地落回到那片荒凉的仙门废墟中央。
光芒散去，姜望身形显现，脚步比离去时稳健了不少。
并非体力原因，而是心中有了底。
此次青木镇之行，虽短暂，却是有所收获。
首先，确认了自身所在的大致方位
苍梧州边境的坠星山脉，一个远离修仙文明，以凡俗武力为主的角落。
这对他而言，既是劣势，也是优势。
劣势在于资源匮乏，信息闭塞。
优势则在于，相对安全，可以安心发育。
其次，也暂时解决了迫在眉睫的生存问题。
储物袋里有他采购回来的物资。
不过青木镇本身物资就紧缺，他能采购到的量十分有限。
仅仅能解一时燃眉之急。
想要在此地长久发展，乃至建设起一个像样的仙门据点，这点东西还远远不够。
最后，也是最重要的一点，他验证了太虚神光在当前状态下的实用性。
无论是快速的代步移动，还是关键时刻的脱身保命，这门血脉神通都显得至关重要。
姜望走向那座赤红色的出生点水晶塔旁。
视线聚焦，只有他能看到的系统提示浮现：
【玩家躯体生成中，预计剩余时间：11小时59分…58分…】
只剩下半天时间了。
得做最后准备了。
他心念微动。
打开了系统的【玩家论坛】界面。
冷清的版面依旧，零星几个帖子大多还是嘲讽之言。
“年度骗局”
、“坐等打脸”
之类的论调占据了主流。
姜望并不意外。
信任需要一点点建立，尤其是在如此匪夷所思的事情上。
content_en:
The speed of Taixu Divine Light is far beyond the comparison of ordinary escape methods. It takes some time to find the way and explore when going there.
When he returned, it was just a cup of tea.
The golden stream of light passed through countless vast forests and mountains, and accurately fell back to the center of the desolate fairy gate ruins.
The light dissipated, and Jiang Wang's figure appeared, his steps much more steady than when he left.
It's not because of physical strength, but because of the confidence in my heart.
Although this trip to Qingmu Town was short, it was fruitful.
First, confirm the general direction of where you are.
The Falling Star Mountains on the border of Cangwu Prefecture is a corner far away from the civilization of cultivating immortals and dominated by secular force.
This is both a disadvantage and an advantage for him.
The disadvantage is lack of resources and lack of information.
The advantage is that it is relatively safe and can be developed with peace of mind.
Secondly, it also temporarily solves the urgent survival problem.
The storage bag contains the supplies he purchased.
However, Qingmu Town itself was in short supply of supplies, and the amount he could purchase was very limited.
It can only solve a temporary urgent need.
If you want to develop here for a long time, or even build a decent Immortal Sect stronghold, this is far from enough.
Finally, and most importantly, he verified the practicality of Taixu Divine Light in the current state.
Whether it is rapid movement or escape at critical moments to save life, this bloodline magical power is crucial.
Jiang Wang walked towards the red birth point crystal tower.
Focusing his gaze, a system prompt that only he could see appeared:
[The player body is being generated, estimated remaining time: 11 hours, 59 minutes...58 minutes...]
Only half a day left.
Gotta make final preparations.
His thoughts moved slightly.
The system's [Player Forum] interface is opened.
The forum remains deserted, and most of the few posts are still sarcastic.
"Scam of the Year"
, "Sit back and wait for a slap in the face"
Arguments like this have become mainstream.
Jiang Wang was not surprised.
Trust needs to be built up little by little, especially when it comes to something so bizarre.
title_en: Chapter 5 The official announcement that everything is ready Chapter 6 Players come to attack Wangxian Sect
